categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Major changes to .github/workflows/ci.yml and ci/test/* scripts replacing cross-compilation with a native VM CI job.
categories.rationale: Adds a native FreeBSD CI job running the full test suite in a VM to catch platform-specific regressions before merge instead of relying on nightly runs. As reviewer fanquake noted, running tests reliably in Core CI is preferable to noisy external nightly failures, though FreeBSD is not a tier-1 release target.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and updates test/functional/test_framework/netutil.py to ignore stderr warnings from lsof on FreeBSD.
categories.rationale: Silences benign lsof memory warnings in netutil.py that cause the functional test runner to report failure on FreeBSD. Within test infrastructure, this is a one-line platform-specific runner fix incidental to the CI change.
